using namespace std;
#define pii pair<int,int>
#define mp make_pair
#define inf 100000000
#define nn 6000
namespace mcmf{
	vector<int> v[nn],rev[nn],cost[nn],cap[nn];
	void add_edge(int x,int y,int c,int w)
	{
		rev[x].push_back(v[y].size());rev[y].push_back(v[x].size());
		v[x].push_back(y);v[y].push_back(x);
		cost[x].push_back(w);cost[y].push_back(-w);
		cap[x].push_back(c);cap[y].push_back(0);
	}
	
	int dist[nn];int vis[nn];
	int prex[nn],prei[nn];
	void spfa(int s)
	{
		memset(dist,0x3f,sizeof dist);
		memset(vis,0,sizeof vis);prex[s]=-1;
		queue<int> q;q.push(s);dist[s]=0;vis[s]=1;
		
		while(q.size())
		{
			int x=q.front();q.pop();vis[x]=0;
			for(int i=0;i<v[x].size();i++)
			{
				int y=v[x][i];
				int cc=dist[x]+cost[x][i];
				if(dist[y]>cc and cap[x][i])
				{
					dist[y]=cc;prex[y]=x,prei[y]=i;
					if(!vis[y]) vis[y]=1,q.push(y);
				}
			}
		}
		
	}
	
	int tot=0;
	int dfs(int x,int flow)
	{
		if(prex[x]==-1) return flow;
		int y=x;x=prex[y];int i=prei[y],j=rev[x][i];
		int f=dfs(x,min(flow,cap[x][i]));
		cap[x][i]-=f,cap[y][j]+=f;
		return f;
	}
	
	pii solve(int s,int t)
	{
		int ans=0;tot=0;
		while(1)
		{
			spfa(s);
			if(dist[t]>1e9) break;
			int f=dfs(t,inf);
			tot+=f*dist[t];
			ans+=f;
		}
		return mp(ans,tot);
	}
	
};

import sys
from collections import deque

class mcmf:
    def __init__(self):
        self.v = [[] for _ in range(6000)]
        self.rev = [[] for _ in range(6000)]
        self.cost = [[] for _ in range(6000)]
        self.cap = [[] for _ in range(6000)]

    def add_edge(self, x, y, c, w):
        self.rev[x].append(len(self.v[y]))
        self.rev[y].append(len(self.v[x]))
        self.v[x].append(y)
        self.v[y].append(x)
        self.cost[x].append(w)
        self.cost[y].append(-w)
        self.cap[x].append(c)
        self.cap[y].append(0)

    def spfa(self, s):
        dist = [float('inf')] * 6000
        vis = [0] * 6000
        prex = [-1] * 6000
        prei = [-1] * 6000
        q = deque()
        q.append(s)
        dist[s] = 0
        vis[s] = 1
        while q:
            x = q.popleft()
            vis[x] = 0
            for i in range(len(self.v[x])):
                y = self.v[x][i]
                cc = dist[x] + self.cost[x][i]
                if dist[y] > cc and self.cap[x][i]:
                    dist[y] = cc
                    prex[y] = x
                    prei[y] = i
                    if not vis[y]:
                        vis[y] = 1
                        q.append(y)

    def dfs(self, x, flow):
        if prex[x] == -1:
            return flow
        y = x
        x = prex[y]
        i = prei[y]
        j = self.rev[x][i]
        f = self.dfs(x, min(flow, self.cap[x][i]))
        self.cap[x][i] -= f
        self.cap[y][j] += f
        return f

    def solve(self, s, t):
        ans = 0
        tot = 0
        while 1:
            self.spfa(s)
            if dist[t] > 1e9:
                break
            f = self.dfs(t, float('inf'))
            tot += f * dist[t]
            ans += f
        return (ans, tot)

n, m, k, c, d = map(int, input().split())

t = 6000 - 2

    for i in range(1, 100):

            mcmf.add_edge(x, y, 1, d * (j + j - 1))
    x, y = y, x
    for i in range(1, 100):
        for j in range(1, k + 1):
            mcmf.add_edge(x, y, 1, d * (j + j - 1))
for i in range(1, 100):
    for j in range(1, n + 1):
        mcmf.add_edge(j, j, float('inf'), 0)
    mcmf.add_edge(1, t, float('inf'), c * (i - 1))
print(mcmf.solve(s, t)[1])
